prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny green meadow full of wildflowers with a dirt path, a wooden fence and gate of normal height, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, dark roots fading smoothly into sun-kissed lighter ends (balayage) hair styled in braided, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted topaz drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a gold hammer head, a silver ship's anchor), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold anklet. Extra long nails in matching polished amber.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body polished honey amber fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid amber curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted amber sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep honey-orange amber surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID tiny trapped air bubbles and dark inclusions swirling through every section, glass-smooth polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved honey amber.

LEFT Cracks: the honey amber body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left hip, and one chipped-off piece at her right forearm, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw dark-brown resin with a rough unpolished surface inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the honey amber is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: classical contrapposto stance, weight on one leg, one hand holding the other forearm low in front of her hips.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved honey amber right down to the shoes.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Jamaican person with a handsome man's face on a full, curvaceous female body — a man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, an elegant handsome young male face with a high nose bridge, a defined jaw, straight brows and a strong neck, clean-shaven, soft peach-pink eyeshadow, subtly glossy lips and a dewy highlight on the cheekbones, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a confident smirk, soft strawberry-blonde hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long brass chain ending in one large faceted aquamarine drop, and on the other ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a silver barrel-shaped weight, a gold square-sided cowbell, a gold pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three platinum rings. Extra long nails in matching polished sodalite.
RIGHT Physique: an extraordinarily tall and enormous woman, far beyond any real person, towering and broad; a commanding, statuesque frame with huge broad shoulders, powerful thick arms with hard defined muscle, a strong deep chest, and a long, dense, muscular torso with only a slight inward taper at the waist; enormous powerful hips and colossal long thighs with hard muscle visible through a soft layer, thick strong calves; not slim, not delicate, powerful, statuesque and imposing; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Body Art: full body polished sodalite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep royal-blue sodalite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID white calcite veins flowing through every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved sodalite.

RIGHT Cracks: the sodalite body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right thigh, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left thigh and one at her right shoulder, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw grey-blue stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the sodalite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
RIGHT Pose: both arms slightly open away from her body, palms turned up, relaxed shoulders.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme peep-toe platform stiletto pumps in cream white leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved sodalite right down to the shoes.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
